authorization.basis: Instrução explícita do usuário nesta conversa para fechamento documental G2 round2
authorization.quote: Ok, pode prosseguir. Mas adota também em algum momento replicarmos algo já feito em outro lugar, pelos autores, para conferirmos que estamos fazendo direito.
authorization.interpretation: Reprodução fiel do qbl/JAGS primeiro, nos limites especificados pelo usuário; não autorização inferencial ou autoaprovação do gate.

decision_resolution.choice: Benchmark literal de software; não corrigir F1/F2, não presumir gerador válido ou semântica runtime
Priors e hierarquia efetivas de JAGS, alpha+b0 e primeiro desenho intercept-only; geografia de produção adiada para G4 antes de G6
Distribuição conjunta completa dos funcionais por draw, médias condicionais separadas e limites condicionais de margem

pi.simplex_density: pi1^(-3) on partial-order domain, with respect to d(pi2)d(pi3)

priors.observation_effect: h[i,b]|alpha[b],v[b] ~ Normal(alpha[b],variance=v[b]); independent conditional on block parameters
priors.predictor: inprod(X_b[i,],beta_b1)+h[i,b]; reported beta_b replaces its first coordinate by alpha but is not used in this product

first_harness.each_matrix: n by 1, all entries exactly 1; each associated coefficient dimension equals 1

wrapper_interface.sentinel_scope: G3 must inspect the actual outgoing JAGS data and design matrices, in wrapper and direct-list paths, and fail on swapped responses; equal responses cannot detect the error. Round2 tests contract fixtures and source text only, not the full wrapper.

latent_counts.class: one Z[i]~Categorical(pi) shared by a[i] and w[i]

likelihood.observed: N integer >=1; A=N-V and W integers in [0,N]; physical input contract A+W<=N remains required but does not fix model support

held_limitations.statement: Positive-mass parent states yield pW>1 (minimal example pW=499.5); runtime handling unknown and not silently repaired.
N-trial observation nodes allow A+W>N even without fraud; software reproduction is not certification of physical support.
Paper/JAGS/Stan targets differ in priors, latent counts, dependence on observed abstention and clamp; choosing JAGS does not refute those differences.
Zero-invalid diagnostic finite sums are not an automatically normalized sampling model or proven runtime policy; conditioning and truncation require explicit parameter-dependent normalizers.
Ordered priors and computational convergence do not establish mechanism identification, intended fraud or empirical validity.
M and S are model functionals, not observed counts. Origin of stolen is unidentified in the aggregate residual; margin bounds need feasibility and stated assumptions.
Intercept-only harness and dummy-prior fidelity tests do not select national production geography. Approval required in G4 before G6.
Completion of historical JAGS/Stan runs did not establish convergence or approve any inferential fit; timing comparisons were not controlled.
Small-case exact sums condition on continuous parameters and on the explicitly defined diagnostic kernel; O(sum N_i^2) is an operation count, not a measured national benchmark.

G3_go_no_go.scope: additional target-fidelity criteria, not a replacement for the existing G3 gate or authorization to execute it now

criteria.requirement: Freeze the consumed literal source hash and record actual JAGS version 4.3.2, wrapper/data hashes and environment; mismatches are no-go for fidelity.

Start with six fixed n-by-1 matrices of ones, full hierarchy and alpha+b0. Verify partial pi prior, Exp5 variances, precisions, four Bin(N,mu) counts and endpoint 0.999; prior/dummy tests do not choose national geography.

On valid small states compare formulas and discrete conditional sums to the explicitly named target, retaining all constants; predeclare numerical tolerances and cases before results. Never compare mean plug-ins as exact marginalization.

Probe invalid-parent runtime with N=A=R_M=1,R_S=0,tau=nu=0.5,W=0 and a valid control; preserve exact model/probe bytes, actual pW, phase, conditions, errors and logs. Test active/inactive class cases and relevant initial/proposal/data-generation stages without assuming error, rejection or zero likelihood.

Any literal generator failure is retained with a support report covering attempts, invalid pW, nonfinite values and A+W>N. No retry-until-valid, clamp, truncation or silent normalizer. Runtime failure may be a faithfully reproduced result, never a certified physical generator.

Output jointly compatible Z and all latent inputs needed for M,S, aggregate within draw and label model functionals; separate conditional means. Verify conditional margin bounds and report infeasible cases without clipping or invented ballot draws.

No-go for unqualified exact-port claims if runtime behavior remains unknown or differs on tested cases; unresolved mismatch or need to repair F1/F2 reopens the affected G2 choice. Independent G3 QA remains mandatory.

Before any fitting, run an asymmetric sentinel a!=w through the actual wrapper and direct-list routes. Require formula1=w~... -> w/Xw and formula2=a~... -> a/Xa, verify emitted JAGS data/matrices and detect a deliberately swapped negative control. Equal or symmetric responses are insufficient.

G3_go_no_go.software_fidelity_go: criteria satisfied with source-bound evidence including reproduced failures and independent review; does not imply probabilistic coherence or inference
